ei.title: Job Opportunity Outlook by Income Level Amid AI Adoption

fullPassage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.

questions.passage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.
questions.stem:
윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Lower-income workers were more __(A)__ about AI's effect on jobs, while upper-income workers were more __(B)__ about the impact.

det.korean: 하위 소득 근로자는 더 비관적(pessimistic)이었고, 상위 소득 근로자는 영향에 대해 더 낙관적(optimistic)이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ pessimistic — optimistic: 하위(감소 1/3 이상) vs 상위(차이 없다 40%+)
❌ ① optimistic: 하위가 낙관적이 아님
❌ ③ indifferent: 무관심이 아님
❌ ② enthusiastic: 열광적이 아님
